verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's own docs show it can compress and optimize PNG and JPG files, and create PNG, JPG or WEBP thumbnails, which gives some first-party control over compression and output size. Nothing documents general image conversion across the listed formats or explicit quality and size parameters; custom ImageMagick commands are a developer building block, not credited here. Missing for 10: documented conversion of HEIC and SVG (and WebP beyond thumbnails), explicit quality/resize/compression options on conversion tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, common image formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, SVG) convert with control over quality, size, and compression

citations.quote: Optimize Files: Compress and optimize PDF, PNG and JPG files.
Create a PNG, JPG or WEBP thumbnail of input files.
